## ACCENT\_LITERAL variable

Literal accent values, for canvas rendering — a `<canvas>` context can't resolve a CSS custom property, so it needs the concrete colour for the current theme. SVG should use [ACCENT\_COLOR](./core.accent_color.md) instead and let CSS pick.

**Signature:**

```typescript
ACCENT_LITERAL: {
    readonly light: "rgb(48, 92, 222)";
    readonly dark: "rgb(125, 163, 255)";
}
```
